4875-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4875-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

643-3510-3875-6291.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-3510-3875-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

184-4682-6753.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
184-4682-6753.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-4682-6753.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

1556-1719-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1556-1719-2645-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-4476.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-4476.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1170-3698-5131-5645--202.easyPrerequisites:
Stenn has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-5645--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat.

2738-4871-5256-6255.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1349-5256-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-5256-6854.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 6.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

560-2757-5285.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

2459-2928-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2459-2928-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6148.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6148.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

147-2292-3125.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
147-2292-3125.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Dualcaster Mage and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

997-2376--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

618-4456-6259-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R} due to Samut.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
618-4456-6259-7494.notes: If your speed is 2 or higher, the starting cost is reduced by {1} and you'll net infinite red mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

206-1563-3899-4365.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1486-4091-7223.notablePrerequisites:
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
Stalactite Dagger on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-4091-7223.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
2011-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-4068.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

944-2034-4871-5496-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1115-2085-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

955-1170-1329-3200.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3200-6968.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1887-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vorinclex.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1887-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

4947-5078-6766-6791.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

1575-2829-6748.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1339-4063-5256-6625.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2034-2308-6559.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-6559.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

677-1283-2034-5102.description:
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {5}, casting Scampering Scorcher from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Scampering Scorcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens and giving Elementals you control haste until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Scampering Scorcher and two Elementals, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

2440-3263-4183-4404.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2440-3263-4183-4404.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
When the token Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Corridor Monitor.
Repeat.

803-1429-5231-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-5231-5402.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {R}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

222-527-647-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-647-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

780-1126-5195.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Xiahou Dun.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Supernatural Stamina.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, targeting Supernatural Stamina.
When Xiahou Dun dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability from step 2, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

413-1020-3003-3689.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
413-1020-3003-3689.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Workshop Assistant.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
 Repeat.

1939-2034-3263-3613.description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {2}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Luminous Phantom.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Luminous Phantom, adding {2}.
Because Dress Down causes Luminous Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.

2146-2493-2562-4050.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying {W}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {W}.
When Archaeomancer dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graceful Reprieve from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

224-1119-1921-5175.notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
"Green" chosen with Caged Sun.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
224-1119-1921-5175.description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Tree of Tales from your graveyard, causing you to create a token of Tree of Tales.
When the Tree of Tales token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate the Tree of Tales token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Tree of Tales token and causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

751-2564-3713-4289.notablePrerequisites: Steelfin Whale does not have summoning sickness.
751-2564-3713-4289.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue token.
The Clue enters the battlefield, triggering Steelfin Whale, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.
